create_vitsconfig_default: create a VitsConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the facebook/mms-tts-eng model
create_vitsconfig_multispeaker: create a VitsConfig instance configured for a multi-speaker VITS text-to-speech model
create_vitsconfig_custom_upsample: create a VitsConfig instance with custom upsample_rates and upsample_kernel_sizes for the HiFi-GAN upsampling network
create_vitsconfig_stochastic_duration: create a VitsConfig instance with stochastic duration prediction enabled and custom noise_scale for speech variation
review_vitsconfig_validate_architecture: review the VitsConfig.validate_architecture method that validates upsample_kernel_sizes and upsample_rates lengths match
